summary: Chose to convert SessionStart prompt-type hook to command-type hook for issue #8
context: Wrote design spec for plugin hygiene fixes (issues #8, #9, #10) at docs/superpowers/specs/. Issue #7 (decision/scope GC) deferred to separate Spec B.
rationale: command hooks emit additionalContext JSON without needing ToolUseContext that resume sessions don't supply. Rejected narrowing matcher to startup-only because resume is exactly when the gate reminder is most useful. Rejected dropping the prompt hook entirely because it loses the moment-of-session signal.
assumptions: #8 root cause is on our side (prompt-type hook config) not waiting for upstream Claude Code fix
Plugin and MCP server bumps will be coordinated minor releases (1.9.0 plugin, 1.19.0 server)
Bash hook scripts will get a uniform 2-line TWINING_DISABLED guard — exit 0 with no JSON is treated as allow/no-op by Claude Code
